mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ast_tree( ast01_class_tree_id , ast01_class_tree_nm , ast01_parent_tree_id , ast01_seq , ast01_class_tree_cd , ast01_type_cd , ast01_isin , depth , path , cycle ) AS ( SELECT ast01_class_tree_id , ast01_class_tree_nm , ast01_parent_tree_id , ast01_seq , ast01_class_tree_cd , ast01_type_cd , ast01_isin , 1 , ARRAY[CAST(a.ast01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.ast01_seq AS varchar),10,'0')||a.ast01_class_tree_cd||LPAD(CAST(a.ast01_class_tree_id AS varchar),15,'0')] , false FROM ast01_class_tree a WHERE 1=1 AND ast01_parent_tree_id = 0 AND ast01_use_yn = 'true' AND ast01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} AND ast01_asset_type LIKE #{c.assetType} AND ast01_company_id = #{c.companyId} UNION ALL SELECT a.ast01_class_tree_id , a.ast01_class_tree_nm , a.ast01_parent_tree_id , a.ast01_seq , a.ast01_class_tree_cd , a.ast01_type_cd , a.ast01_isin , b.depth + 1 , array_append(b.path, CAST(a.ast01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.ast01_seq AS varchar),10,'0')||a.ast01_class_tree_cd||LPAD(CAST(a.ast01_class_tree_id AS varchar),15,'0')) , a.ast01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM ast01_class_tree a INNER JOIN ast_tree b ON a.ast01_parent_tree_id = b.ast01_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.ast01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.ast01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} AND a.ast01_asset_type LIKE #{c.assetType} AND a.ast01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND not cycle ) SELECT a.ast01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , a.ast01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id , a.ast01_class_tree_nm ||CASE WHEN a.ast01_type_cd != 'IT' THEN '' ELSE (CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.ast01_isin,'X') != 'X' THEN ' ('||a.ast01_isin||')' ELSE '' END) END AS class_tree_name , a.ast01_type_cd AS type_code , a.depth AS depth FROM ast_tree a WHERE 1=1 AND ( ( a.ast01_type_cd = 'IT' AND ( ( #{c.userId} IN ( SELECT ast10_person_id FROM ast10_manager WHERE ast10_manager_type = '1' AND ast10_link_id = a.ast01_class_tree_id ) ) OR ( #{c.orgId} IN ( SELECT ast10_org_id FROM ast10_manager WHERE ast10_manager_type = '2' AND ast10_link_id = a.ast01_class_tree_id ) ) ) ) OR ( a.ast01_type_cd != 'IT' ) ) ORDER BY path

SELECT a.ast01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , a.ast01_isin AS isin , a.ast01_class_tree_full_nm AS class_tree_full_name FROM ( SELECT distinct ast01_class_tree.ast01_class_tree_id , ast01_class_tree.ast01_isin , f_ast_class_tree_nm_allpath2(ast01_class_tree_id) as ast01_class_tree_full_nm FROM ast01_class_tree , fnd10_book WHERE ast01_class_tree_id = fnd10_ast_class_tree_id AND ast01_type_cd = 'IT' AND ast01_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast01_asset_type = #{assetType} AND fnd10_std_date = #{stdDate} ) a WHERE upper(ast01_isin||ast01_class_tree_full_nm) like '%'||upper(#{searchText})||'%' ORDER BY ast01_class_tree_full_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc

SELECT t.ast01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , t.ast01_company_id AS company_id , t.ast01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id , t.ast01_seq AS seq , t.ast01_isin AS isin , t.ast01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , t.ast01_class_tree_cd AS class_tree_code , t.ast01_use_yn AS use_yn , t.ast01_note AS note , CONCAT( ast01_item_l_class_nm , '/' || ast01_item_m_class_nm , '/' || ast01_item_s_class_nm , '/' || ast01_item_d_class_nm ) AS item_class_name FROM ( SELECT * , f_cdnm('ItemLClassCode', ast01_item_l_class_cd, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS ast01_item_l_class_nm , f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode', ast01_item_m_class_cd, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS ast01_item_m_class_nm , f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode', ast01_item_s_class_cd, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS ast01_item_s_class_nm , f_cdnm('ItemDClassCode', ast01_item_d_class_cd, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS ast01_item_d_class_nm FROM ast01_class_tree WHERE ast01_parent_tree_id = #{parentId} AND ast01_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast01_type_cd = #{typeCode} ) t ORDER BY ast01_seq

SELECT ast01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , ast01_company_id AS company_id , ast01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id , ast01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , ast01_class_tree_cd AS class_tree_code , ast01_seq AS seq , ast01_type_cd AS type_code , ast01_note AS note , ast01_use_yn AS use_yn , ast01_content AS content , ast01_isin AS isin , ast01_item_l_class_cd AS item_l_class_code , ast01_item_m_class_cd AS item_m_class_code , ast01_item_s_class_cd AS item_s_class_code , ast01_item_d_class_cd AS item_d_class_code , ast01_account_type AS account_type , ast01_asset_type AS asset_type , ast01_tr_unit AS tr_unit , ast01_issue_date AS issue_date , ast01_mat_date AS mat_date , ast01_corp_id AS corp_id , ast01_cur_cd AS cur_code , ast01_depn_year AS depn_year , ast01_depn_rt AS depn_rate , ast01_depn_type AS depn_type , ast01_eval_type AS eval_type , f_cdnm('ItemLClassCode', ast01_item_l_class_cd, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS item_l_class_name , f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode', ast01_item_m_class_cd, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS item_m_class_name , f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode', ast01_item_s_class_cd, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS item_s_class_name , f_cdnm('ItemDClassCode', ast01_item_d_class_cd, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS item_d_class_name , f_cdnm('AssetEvalType', ast01_eval_type, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS eval_type_name , f_cdnm('AccountType', ast01_account_type, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS account_name , f_cdnm('AssetType', ast01_asset_type, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS asset_name , f_cdnm('DepnType', ast01_depn_type, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS depn_type_name , f_get_corp_nm(ast01_corp_id) AS corp_name , f_cdnm('CurCode', ast01_cur_cd, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cur_name , f_ast_class_tree_nm_allpath(ast01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , COALESCE(f_ast_class_tree_nm_allpath(ast01_parent_tree_id),'없음') AS parent_tree_full_name , 1 AS depth FROM ast01_class_tree WHERE ast01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}
